cond_0001.intro:
The Clinical Research Nursing Provider is a member of the [Company name masked] Clinical Research Unit, a global organization with Clinical Research Units in [Location masked] and [Location masked].
The Clinical Research Units conduct early clinical trials with healthy volunteers. This individual is responsible for data and sample collection and the safety of trial subjects. This individual focuses on the clinical nursing requirements of [Product name masked] study protocols that yield reliable, high quality research outcomes, and valid scientific data and findings.
This individual is also responsible for performing self-daily check on all data for accuracy and completeness, as well as maintaining source documentation. They demonstrate ability and flexibility to work alternative or additional hours internally and externally (weekends/evenings/nights) to provide study activity coverage.
They provide direct, face-to-face instruction and support to the trial subjects with an emphasis on participants safety and comfort including basic first aid and supportive nursing care as needed.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Executes clinical research studies in accordance with scientific, medical, and ethical principles, within regulatory requirements/guidelines, and [Company name masked] SOPs.
Executes and is responsible for protocol required data and sample collection in accordance with ALCOA standards from screening until last final visit.
Responsible for volunteer/patient safety including code carts and clinical supplies maintenance and readiness.
Observes and communicates to the medical provider, records, and updates any adverse event.
Provides patient care within scope of licensure as needed under the supervision of medical provider.
Responsible for self-daily check on data collected during study activities.
Executes and is responsible for multiple study activities including nursing assessment of physiologic response to drug administration, administration of study medications in accordance with protocol specified instructions and local SOPs, administration of concomitant drug and non-drug treatments based on subject presentation and medical provider recommendation, cardiac monitoring, basic nursing care and emergency interventions.
Maintains proficiency in multiple methods and forms of data collection (i.e., ECGs, V/S, venipuncture, telemetry, etc.)
Provides instructions and assistance to clinical research participants.
Assists in human biological sample management including generation of identifying labels, collection and associated source document completion as needed.
Maintains equipment log & calibration records as needed.
Maintains adequate levels of clinical supplies for data collection, clinical care and emergency readiness.
At discretion of Clinical Services Manager, functions as an asset owner to keep equipment in functioning order through preventative maintenance and calibration.
Reports and documents any issue/incident/discrepancies in the conduct of a study.
Answers and resolves any query sent by project manager or clinical coordinator.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Nursing or equivalent Life Science/Biomedical or Health Care related education or experience.
Current BLS/ILS/ACLS certification.
Current Healthcare licensure as applicable per state/country statute.
Excellent knowledge of medical conditions, medical terminology, nursing and research techniques, and application of clinical research.
Nursing and emergency interventions are appropriate, immediate, and demonstrate excellent assessment skills and standard of care.
Ability to review and understand emerging safety data of a drug candidate and recognize potential serious adverse effects.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Able to work effectively in multifunctional, interdepartmental management teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft (MS) Office and the ability to learn different software programs.
Working knowledge of computers (e-HR) and laboratory data handling acquisition systems and associated issues/risks.
Preferred Requirements
Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in a health-related discipline including competency in phlebotomy/venipuncture techniques, and performing electrocardiograms.
Experience in a pharmaceutical or medical research position.
Experience and understanding of effective electronic and distance communication methods (i.e. Email, Video Conferencing, IM).
Understanding and comprehension of scientific writing.
Bilingual ability to speak, read, and write Spanish.
Change agile: open and receptive, flexible and adaptable.
Business oriented.
Action-oriented: achieve departmental goals.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is flexible, innovative, and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in development, maintenance, compliance or analysis through research programs, your contribution will directly impact patients.
The Clinical Research Nursing Provider is a member of the [Company name masked] Clinical Research Unit which is a global organization with Clinical Research Units in [Location masked] and [Location masked].
The Clinical Research Units operate for the purpose of conducting early clinical trials with healthy volunteers. This individual owns responsibility for data and sample collection and safety of the trial subjects. This individual leads the clinical nursing requirements of [Product name masked] study protocols that yield reliable, high quality research outcomes, and valid scientific data and findings.
This individual is also accountable for performing self-daily check on all data for accuracy and completeness, as well as maintaining source documentation. They demonstrate ability and flexibility to work alternative or additional hours internally and externally (weekends/evenings/nights) to provide study activity coverage.
They deliver direct, face-to-face instruction and support to the trial subjects with an emphasis on participants safety and comfort including basic first aid and supportive nursing care as needed.
cond_0035.responsibilities:
Executes clinical research studies in accordance with scientific, medical, and ethical principles, within regulatory requirements/guidelines, and [Company name masked] SOPs.
Owns and executes protocol required data and sample collection in accordance with ALCOA standards from screening until last final visit.
Accountable for volunteer/patient safety including code carts and clinical supplies maintenance and readiness.
Observes and directly communicates to the medical provider, records, and resolves any adverse event.
Delivers patient care within scope of licensure as needed under the supervision of medical provider.
Accountable for self-daily check on data collected during study activities.
Executes and takes ownership of multiple study activities including nursing assessment of physiologic response to drug administration, administration of study medications in accordance with protocol specified instructions and local SOPs, administration of concomitant drug and non-drug treatments based on subject presentation and medical provider recommendation, cardiac monitoring, basic nursing care and emergency interventions.
Maintains proficiency in multiple methods and forms of data collection (i.e., ECGs, V/S, venipuncture, telemetry, etc.)
Provides instructions and assistance to clinical research participants.
Directs human biological sample management including generation of identifying labels, collection and associated source document completion as needed.
Maintains equipment log & calibration records as needed.
Maintains adequate levels of clinical supplies for data collection, clinical care and emergency readiness.
At discretion of Clinical Services Manager, functions as an asset owner to keep equipment in functioning order through preventative maintenance and calibration.
Reports and documents any issue/incident/discrepancies in the conduct of a study.
Resolves any query sent by project manager or clinical coordinator.
cond_0035.requirements:
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in Nursing or equivalent ""Life Science/Biomedical"" or ""Health Care"" related education or experience.
Current BLS/ILS/ACLS certification.
Current Healthcare licensure as applicable per state/country statute.
Experience in pharmaceutical or medical research position is an asset.
Nursing and emergency interventions are appropriate, immediate, and demonstrate excellent assessment skills and standard of care.
Experience and understanding of effective electronic and distance communication methods (i.e. Email, Video Conferencing, IM).
Proficiency in Microsoft (MS) Office and the ability to learn different software programs.
Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in a health-related discipline including competency in phlebotomy/venipuncture techniques, and performing electrocardiograms is highly preferred.
Working knowledge of computers (e-HR) and laboratory data handling acquisition systems and associated issues/risks.
Excellent knowledge of medical conditions, medical terminology, nursing and research techniques, and application of clinical research.
Understanding and comprehension of scientific writing.
Ability to review and understand emerging safety data of a drug candidate and recognize potential serious adverse effects.
Bilingual ability to speak, read, and write Spanish is highly desirable.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Able to work effectively in multifunctional, interdepartmental management teams.
Change agile: open and receptive, flexible and adaptable.
Business oriented.
Action-oriented: achieve departmental goals.

cond_0042.intro:
Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is flexible, innovative, and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in development, maintenance, compliance or analysis through research programs, your contribution will directly impact patients.
The Clinical Research Nursing Provider is a member of the [Company name masked] Clinical Research Unit which is a global organization with Clinical Research Units in [Location masked] and [Location masked].
The Clinical Research Units operate for the purpose of conducting early clinical trials with healthy volunteers. This individual assures and is responsible for data and sample collection and safety of the trial subjects. This individual focuses on the clinical nursing requirements of [Product name masked] study protocols that yield reliable, high quality research outcomes, and valid scientific data and findings.
This individual is also responsible for performing self-daily check on all data for accuracy and completeness, as well as maintaining source documentation. They demonstrate ability and flexibility to work alternative or additional hours internally and externally (weekends/evenings/nights) to provide study activity coverage.
They provide direct, face-to-face instruction and support to the trial subjects, staying in regular contact with participants with an emphasis on safety and comfort including basic first aid and supportive nursing care as needed.
cond_0042.responsibilities:
Executes clinical research studies in accordance with scientific, medical, and ethical principles, within regulatory requirements/guidelines, and [Company name masked] SOPs.
Executes and is responsible for protocol required data and sample collection in accordance with ALCOA standards from screening until last final visit.
Responsible for volunteer/patient safety including code carts and clinical supplies maintenance and readiness.
Observes and actively communicates to the medical provider, records, and updates any adverse event.
Provides patient care within scope of licensure as needed under the supervision of medical provider.
Responsible for self-daily check on data collected during study activities.
Executes and is responsible for multiple study activities including nursing assessment of physiologic response to drug administration, administration of study medications in accordance with protocol specified instructions and local SOPs, administration of concomitant drug and non-drug treatments based on subject presentation and medical provider recommendation, cardiac monitoring, basic nursing care and emergency interventions.
Maintains proficiency in multiple methods and forms of data collection (i.e., ECGs, V/S, venipuncture, telemetry, etc.)
Provides direct instructions and hands-on assistance to clinical research participants on a daily basis.
Assists in human biological sample management including generation of identifying labels, collection and associated source document completion as needed.
Maintains equipment log & calibration records as needed.
Maintains adequate levels of clinical supplies for data collection, clinical care and emergency readiness.
At discretion of Clinical Services Manager, functions as an asset owner to keep equipment in functioning order through preventative maintenance and calibration.
Reports and documents any issue/incident/discrepancies in the conduct of a study.
Answers and resolves any query sent by project manager or clinical coordinator, initiating follow-up contact as needed to reach resolution.

cond_0084.intro:
We are looking for a Clinical Research Nursing Provider to join our team.
The Clinical Research Nursing Provider is a member of the [Company name masked] Clinical Research Unit which is a global organization with Clinical Research Units in [Location masked] and [Location masked].
The Clinical Research Units operate for the purpose of conducting early clinical trials with healthy volunteers. This individual assures and is responsible for data and sample collection and safety of the trial subjects. This individual focuses on the clinical nursing requirements of [Product name masked] study protocols that yield reliable, high quality research outcomes, and valid scientific data and findings.
This individual is also responsible for performing self-daily check on all data for accuracy and completeness, as well as maintaining source documentation. They demonstrate ability and flexibility to work alternative or additional hours internally and externally (weekends/evenings/nights) to provide study activity coverage.
They provide direct, face-to-face instruction and support to the trial subjects with an emphasis on participants safety and comfort including basic first aid and supportive nursing care as needed.
cond_0084.responsibilities:
Executes clinical research studies in accordance with scientific, medical, and ethical principles, within regulatory requirements/guidelines, and [Company name masked] SOPs.
Executes and is responsible for protocol required data and sample collection in accordance with ALCOA standards from screening until last final visit.
Responsible for volunteer/patient safety including code carts and clinical supplies maintenance and readiness.
Observes and communicates to the medical provider, records, and updates any adverse event.
Provides patient care within scope of licensure as needed under the supervision of medical provider.
Responsible for self-daily check on data collected during study activities.
Executes and is responsible for multiple study activities including nursing assessment of physiologic response to drug administration, administration of study medications in accordance with protocol specified instructions and local SOPs, administration of concomitant drug and non-drug treatments based on subject presentation and medical provider recommendation, cardiac monitoring, basic nursing care and emergency interventions.
Maintains proficiency in multiple methods and forms of data collection (i.e., ECGs, V/S, venipuncture, telemetry, etc.)
Provides instructions and assistance to clinical research participants.
Assists in human biological sample management including generation of identifying labels, collection and associated source document completion as needed.
Maintains equipment log & calibration records as needed.
Maintains adequate levels of clinical supplies for data collection, clinical care and emergency readiness.
At discretion of Clinical Services Manager, functions as an asset owner to keep equipment in functioning order through preventative maintenance and calibration.
Reports and documents any issue/incident/discrepancies in the conduct of a study.
Answers and resolves any query sent by project manager or clinical coordinator.
cond_0084.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Nursing or equivalent Life Science, Biomedical, or Health Care related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Current BLS/ILS/ACLS certification, or willingness to obtain.
Current Healthcare licensure as applicable per state/country statute.
Experience in a pharmaceutical or medical research position is an asset.
Comfort with nursing and emergency interventions, with a willingness to develop assessment skills and maintain a solid standard of care.
Familiarity with effective electronic and distance communication methods (i.e. Email, Video Conferencing, IM).
Working knowledge of Microsoft (MS) Office and the ability to learn different software programs.
Around 2 years of relevant work experience in a health-related discipline, including some background in phlebotomy/venipuncture techniques and performing electrocardiograms, is preferred; an equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
Background in computers (e-HR) and laboratory data handling acquisition systems and associated issues/risks.
Working knowledge of medical conditions, medical terminology, nursing and research techniques, and application of clinical research.
Exposure to scientific writing and an ability to read and understand it.
Ability to review emerging safety data of a drug candidate and recognize potential serious adverse effects.
Bilingual ability to speak, read, and write Spanish is desirable.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Willingness to work collaboratively in multifunctional, interdepartmental teams.
Openness to change: flexible and adaptable.
Action-oriented with an ability to contribute to departmental goals.

cond_0142.intro:
The Clinical Research Nursing Provider is a member of the [Company name masked] Clinical Research Unit, a global organization with Clinical Research Units in [Location masked] and [Location masked].
The Clinical Research Units conduct early clinical trials with healthy volunteers. This individual is responsible for data and sample collection and the safety of trial subjects. The role focuses on the clinical nursing requirements of [Product name masked] study protocols to yield reliable, high quality research outcomes and valid scientific data.
This individual is also responsible for performing a self-daily check on all data for accuracy and completeness, as well as maintaining source documentation. The role requires flexibility to work alternative or additional hours (weekends/evenings/nights) to provide study activity coverage.
This individual provides direct instruction and support to trial subjects, with an emphasis on participant safety and comfort, including basic first aid and supportive nursing care as needed.
cond_0142.responsibilities:
Executes clinical research studies in accordance with scientific, medical, and ethical principles, within regulatory requirements/guidelines, and [Company name masked] SOPs.
Executes and is responsible for protocol-required data and sample collection in accordance with ALCOA standards from screening until last final visit.
Responsible for volunteer/patient safety including code carts and clinical supplies maintenance and readiness.
Observes, records, and updates any adverse event, and reports findings to the medical provider.
Provides patient care within scope of licensure as needed under the supervision of the medical provider.
Responsible for self-daily check on data collected during study activities.
Executes and is responsible for multiple study activities including nursing assessment of physiologic response to drug administration, administration of study medications per protocol instructions and local SOPs, administration of concomitant drug and non-drug treatments based on subject presentation and medical provider recommendation, cardiac monitoring, basic nursing care, and emergency interventions.
Maintains proficiency in multiple methods and forms of data collection (e.g., ECGs, V/S, venipuncture, telemetry).
Provides instructions and assistance to clinical research participants.
Assists in human biological sample management including generation of identifying labels, collection, and associated source document completion as needed.
Maintains equipment log and calibration records as needed.
Maintains adequate levels of clinical supplies for data collection, clinical care, and emergency readiness.
At discretion of Clinical Services Manager, functions as an asset owner to keep equipment in functioning order through preventative maintenance and calibration.
Reports and documents any issue, incident, or discrepancy in the conduct of a study.
Addresses and resolves queries from the project manager or clinical coordinator.

Minimum of a bachelor's degree in Nursing or equivalent Life Science/Biomedical or Health Care related education or experience.
Current BLS/ILS/ACLS certification.
Current healthcare licensure as applicable per state/country statute.

Nursing and emergency interventions are appropriate, immediate, and demonstrate sound assessment skills and standard of care.
Experience and understanding of electronic and distance communication methods (e.g., email, video conferencing, IM).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to learn different software programs.
Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in a health-related discipline, including competency in phlebotomy/venipuncture techniques and performing electrocardiograms is highly preferred.
Working knowledge of computers (e-HR) and laboratory data handling acquisition systems and associated issues/risks.
Solid knowledge of medical conditions, medical terminology, nursing and research techniques, and application of clinical research.
Understanding and comprehension of scientific writing.
Ability to review and understand emerging safety data of a drug candidate and recognize potential serious adverse effects.
Bilingual ability to speak, read, and write Spanish is highly desirable.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills.
Able to work effectively in multifunctional, interdepartmental teams.
Open and adaptable to change.
Action-oriented: focused on achieving departmental goals.

Experience with electronic and distance communication methods (e.g., email, video conferencing, IM).
Comfort with Microsoft Office and willingness to learn different software programs.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to work in multifunctional, interdepartmental teams.

cond_0224.intro:
We are looking for a Clinical Research Nursing Provider to join our team.
The Clinical Research Nursing Provider is a member of the [Company name masked] Clinical Research Unit, a global organization with Clinical Research Units in [Location masked] and [Location masked].
The Clinical Research Units conduct early clinical trials with healthy volunteers. In this role, you will own data and sample collection and take direct accountability for the safety of trial subjects. You will drive the clinical nursing requirements of [Product name masked] study protocols to deliver reliable, high-quality research outcomes and valid scientific data.
You will also take ownership of daily self-checks on all data for accuracy and completeness, and maintain source documentation. You will demonstrate the flexibility to work alternative or additional hours (weekends/evenings/nights) to ensure study activity coverage.
You will deliver direct, face-to-face instruction to trial subjects, with a focus on participant safety and comfort, including basic first aid and supportive nursing care as needed.
cond_0224.responsibilities:
Execute clinical research studies in accordance with scientific, medical, and ethical principles, within regulatory requirements/guidelines, and [Company name masked] SOPs.
Own and execute protocol-required data and sample collection in accordance with ALCOA standards from screening through last final visit.
Take direct accountability for volunteer/patient safety, including code cart and clinical supplies maintenance and readiness.
Observe, record, and communicate any adverse event to the medical provider, and keep records updated.
Deliver patient care within scope of licensure as needed under the supervision of the medical provider.
Conduct self-daily checks on data collected during study activities.
Lead and execute multiple study activities including: nursing assessment of physiologic response to drug administration; administration of study medications per protocol instructions and local SOPs; administration of concomitant drug and non-drug treatments based on subject presentation and medical provider recommendation; cardiac monitoring; basic nursing care; and emergency interventions.
Maintain proficiency in multiple methods and forms of data collection (e.g., ECGs, V/S, venipuncture, telemetry).
Deliver instructions and assistance to clinical research participants.
Manage human biological sample handling, including generation of identifying labels, collection, and associated source document completion as needed.
Maintain equipment logs and calibration records as needed.
Ensure adequate levels of clinical supplies for data collection, clinical care, and emergency readiness.
At the discretion of the Clinical Services Manager, function as an asset owner to keep equipment in working order through preventative maintenance and calibration.
Report and document any issue, incident, or discrepancy in the conduct of a study.
Resolve queries sent by the project manager or clinical coordinator.
cond_0224.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Nursing or equivalent Life Science, Biomedical, or Health Care related education or experience
Current BLS/ILS/ACLS certification
Current healthcare licensure as applicable per state/country statute
Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience in a health-related discipline, including competency in phlebotomy/venipuncture techniques and performing electrocardiograms
Excellent knowledge of medical conditions, medical terminology, nursing and research techniques, and application of clinical research
Nursing and emergency interventions that are appropriate, immediate, and demonstrate strong assessment skills and standard of care
Ability to review and understand emerging safety data of a drug candidate and recognize potential serious adverse effects
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Working knowledge of computers (e-HR) and laboratory data handling acquisition systems and associated issues/risks
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn different software programs
Preferred Requirements
Experience in a pharmaceutical or medical research position
Experience and understanding of effective electronic and distance communication methods (e.g., email, video conferencing, IM)
Understanding and comprehension of scientific writing
Bilingual ability to speak, read, and write Spanish
Ability to work effectively in multifunctional, interdepartmental management teams
Open, flexible, and adaptable to change
Action-oriented with ability to achieve departmental goals

The Clinical Research Units conduct early clinical trials with healthy volunteers. This individual is responsible for data and sample collection and the safety of trial subjects. This individual focuses on the clinical nursing requirements of [Product name masked] study protocols that yield reliable, high quality research outcomes, and valid scientific data and findings.
This individual is also responsible for performing self-daily check on all data for accuracy and completeness, as well as maintaining source documentation. They demonstrate ability and flexibility to work alternative or additional hours internally and externally (weekends/evenings/nights) to provide study activity coverage.
They provide direct, face-to-face instruction and support to the trial subjects with an emphasis on participants safety and comfort including basic first aid and supportive nursing care as needed.
cond_0307.responsibilities:
Executes clinical research studies in accordance with scientific, medical, and ethical principles, within regulatory requirements/guidelines, and [Company name masked] SOPs.
Executes and is responsible for protocol required data and sample collection in accordance with ALCOA standards from screening until last final visit.
Responsible for volunteer/patient safety including code carts and clinical supplies maintenance and readiness.
Observes and communicates to the medical provider, records, and updates any adverse event.
Provides patient care within scope of licensure as needed under the supervision of medical provider.
Responsible for self-daily check on data collected during study activities.
Executes and is responsible for multiple study activities including nursing assessment of physiologic response to drug administration, administration of study medications in accordance with protocol specified instructions and local SOPs, administration of concomitant drug and non-drug treatments based on subject presentation and medical provider recommendation, cardiac monitoring, basic nursing care and emergency interventions.
Maintains proficiency in multiple methods and forms of data collection (i.e., ECGs, V/S, venipuncture, telemetry, etc.)
Provides instructions and assistance to clinical research participants.
Assists in human biological sample management including generation of identifying labels, collection and associated source document completion as needed.
Maintains equipment log & calibration records as needed.
Maintains adequate levels of clinical supplies for data collection, clinical care and emergency readiness.
At discretion of Clinical Services Manager, functions as an asset owner to keep equipment in functioning order through preventative maintenance and calibration.
Reports and documents any issue/incident/discrepancies in the conduct of a study.
Answers and resolves any query sent by project manager or clinical coordinator.
cond_0307.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Nursing or equivalent Life Science/Biomedical or Health Care related education or experience.
Current BLS/ILS/ACLS certification.
Current Healthcare licensure as applicable per state/country statute.
Excellent knowledge of medical conditions, medical terminology, nursing and research techniques, and application of clinical research.
Nursing and emergency interventions are appropriate, immediate, and demonstrate excellent assessment skills and standard of care.
Ability to review and understand emerging safety data of a drug candidate and recognize potential serious adverse effects.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Able to work effectively in multifunctional, interdepartmental management teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft (MS) Office and the ability to learn different software programs.
Working knowledge of computers (e-HR) and laboratory data handling acquisition systems and associated issues/risks.
Preferred Requirements
Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in a health-related discipline including competency in phlebotomy/venipuncture techniques, and performing electrocardiograms.
Experience in a pharmaceutical or medical research position.
Experience and understanding of effective electronic and distance communication methods (i.e. Email, Video Conferencing, IM).
Understanding and comprehension of scientific writing.
Bilingual ability to speak, read, and write Spanish.
Change agile: open and receptive, flexible and adaptable.
Business oriented.
Action-oriented: achieve departmental goals.

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is flexible, innovative, and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in development, maintenance, compliance or analysis through research programs, your contribution will directly impact patients.
The Clinical Research Nursing Provider is a member of the [Company name masked] Clinical Research Unit which is a global organization with Clinical Research Units in [Location masked] and [Location masked].
The Clinical Research Units operate for the purpose of conducting early clinical trials with healthy volunteers. This individual assures and is responsible for data and sample collection and safety of the trial subjects. This individual focuses on the clinical nursing requirements of [Product name masked] study protocols that yield reliable, high quality research outcomes, and valid scientific data and findings.
This individual is also responsible for performing self-daily check on all data for accuracy and completeness, as well as maintaining source documentation. They demonstrate ability and flexibility to work alternative or additional hours internally and externally to provide study activity coverage.

cond_0564.intro:
Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is flexible, innovative, and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in development, maintenance, compliance or analysis through research programs, your contribution will directly impact patients.
The Clinical Research Nursing Provider is a member of the [Company name masked] Clinical Research Unit which is a global organization with Clinical Research Units in [Location masked] and [Location masked].
The Clinical Research Units operate for the purpose of conducting early clinical trials with healthy volunteers. This individual assures and is responsible for data and sample collection and safety of the trial subjects. This individual focuses on the clinical nursing requirements of [Product name masked] study protocols that yield reliable, high quality research outcomes, and valid scientific data and findings.
This individual is also responsible for performing self-daily check on all data for accuracy and completeness, as well as maintaining source documentation. They provide direct, face-to-face instruction and support to the trial subjects, staying in regular contact with participants with an emphasis on safety and comfort including basic first aid and supportive nursing care as needed.
